meta.title: Add Zstd decompression to HTTP client
meta.body_summary: Add Zstd decompression and encoding support to Bun's HTTP client with streaming decompressor for fetch responses.

perf_labels.notes: Codex added zstd support with streaming; dylan-conway reviewed Zig error-handling patterns and provided inline suggestions that were adopted before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1475 changed lines across 10 files, this is a medium-sized feature addition by absolute volume, primarily concentrated in new JSZstd implementation (~424 lines) and tests (~798 lines). It fits a moderate incremental performance enhancement that merged after one round of correctness-focused review.

review_details.concern_detail: dylan-conway suggested using 'try' for allocator calls instead of 'catch' to match Bun's Zig error handling style, and correct async error returns from 'error.JSError' instead of 'error.Zero'.
review_details.performance_claim: Support zstd in HTTP Accept-Encoding and decoding for improved compression efficiency.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Codex produced functional zstd implementation but struggled with idiomatic Zig error handling (catch vs try) and error return types, requiring maintainer corrections.

detection_detail.code_reading: dylan-conway reviewed the allocator and error handling patterns in BunObject.zig, providing inline suggestions to use 'try' and correct error returns.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Tests exist and CI ran, but no specific benchmark or profiling data was provided to validate performance improvement beyond feature functionality.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All review suggestions were addressed by author (Jarred-Sumner) in follow-up commits before merging.

core_change_summary.description: Added Zstandard (zstd) decompression support to Bun's HTTP client by implementing JSZstd struct in BunObject.zig with compressSync/decompressSync and async versions, extending zstd.zig bindings, and wiring Accept-Encoding and response decoding in http.zig. Includes comprehensive test suite.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line changes are in the test file (798 lines), reflecting extensive test coverage for the new feature.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added zstd decompression bindings and HTTP client support.
Iterative WIP commits refined the implementation, added JS-level API and tests.
Multiple inline suggestions from dylan-conway were adopted via co-authored commits.
Prettier formatting, cleanup, and test expansion completed before merge.

review_signals.summary: Return error.JSError instead of an empty tuple when hasException() in getOptionsAsync.
Return error.JSError instead of .zero when hasException() in compressSync.
Use 'try allocator.alloc(u8, max_size)' instead of catch block for compression output buffer.
Use 'try allocator.realloc(output, compressed_size)' instead of catch with fallback slice.
Use 'try allocator.alloc(u8, decompressed_size)' for decompression output.
Use 'try allocator.realloc(job.output, size)' in async compression path with proper error handling.
Reject async promise with error.JSError instead of error.ZSTD on exception.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial zstd HTTP implementation by Jarred-Sumner using OpenAI_Codex.
dylan-conway provided 7 inline review comments focusing on Zig error handling patterns about 5.8 hours later.
Jarred-Sumner adopted all suggestions in co-authored commits over the next hours.
Additional cleanup and test revisions were pushed; merged after ~9.3 hours total lifespan.
